caseName: International Union, United Automobile, Aircraft & Agricultural Implement Workers v. Great Lakes Greyhound Lines
caseNameFull: International Union, United Automobile, Aircraft and Agricultural Implement Workers of America, CIO v. Great Lakes Greyhound Lines
attorneys: Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent. Harold A. Cranefield for appellants. Edmund M. Brady for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Michigan.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent. Harold A. Cranefield for appellants. Edmund M. Brady for appellee.
